how_to_apply: The application mode is online only. The advertisement states that details of eligibility, terms and conditions, instructions and online applications will be available on the website www.join.afms.gov.in from 22 Sep 2026 onwards.

Confirm that you meet every eligibility condition: Indian citizenship, BDS with minimum 55% in final year or MDS from a DCI-recognised institution, completion of the one-year Compulsory Rotatory Internship by 30 Jun 2026, a Permanent Dental Registration Certificate valid up to at least 31 Dec 2026, and appearance in NEET (MDS)-2026.
Visit the official website www.join.afms.gov.in on or after 22 Sep 2026.
Read the detailed eligibility conditions, terms and conditions, and instructions published there for Army Dental Corps SSC 2026.
Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, academic and registration details.
Attach a copy of the NEET (MDS)-2026 Mark-sheet or Score card, which is required to be submitted along with the application.
Submit the completed online application on or before the last date, 22 Oct 2026.

Document specifications, photograph and signature formats, and any fee payment procedure are not specified in the provided notification and should be checked in the detailed instructions on the official website.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Online applications are invited from Indian citizens. Both male and female candidates are eligible to apply. Candidates must be BDS or MDS degree holders. For BDS, a minimum of 55% marks in the final year BDS is required. The degree must have been passed from a College or University recognised by the Dental Council of India (DCI). In addition, the candidate must have completed the one-year Compulsory Rotatory Internship, as mandated by DCI, by 30 Jun 2026, and must be in possession of a Permanent Dental Registration Certificate of a State Dental Council or DCI that is valid at least up to 31 Dec 2026. This is a decisive eligibility filter. Only those BDS or MDS candidates who have appeared in the National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test, NEET (MDS)-2026, conducted by the National Board of Examinations (NBE), New Delhi, under the aegis of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, on 02 May 2026 at various examination centres of NBE, are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q1. What is Army Dental Corps Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive in which online applications are invited from Indian citizens, both male and female, for the grant of Short Service Commission in the Army Dental Corps 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Army Dental Corps Recruitment 2026?
Q3. What is the last date to apply for Army Dental Corps SSC Officer 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 22 Oct 2026.

faq.question: Q4. When does the Army Dental Corps 2026 online application start?
faq.answer: Details of eligibility, terms and conditions, instructions and the online application will be available on www.join.afms.gov.in from 22 Sep 2026 onwards.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Army Dental Corps SSC Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a BDS degree with minimum 55% marks in final year BDS, or an MDS degree, passed from a College or University recognised by the Dental Council of India. They must have completed the one-year Compulsory Rotatory Internship by 30 Jun 2026 and must hold a Permanent Dental Registration Certificate of the State Dental Council or DCI valid at least up to 31 Dec 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is NEET (MDS)-2026 compulsory for Army Dental Corps Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Only those BDS or MDS candidates who appeared in NEET (MDS)-2026, conducted by NBE, New Delhi on 02 May 2026, are eligible to apply, and a copy of the NEET (MDS)-2026 Mark-sheet or Score card must be submitted with the application.
